summary: Router 0.32.4 (fixes #162): while a node's agent reports are fresh (Node.ollama_push_active), poll_node keeps the model list of the agent's last report and applies only the polled loaded models. Before, an on-demand poll (end of a prewarm, after a cold load, a measurement, a wake-up) replaced the reported list with the standby Ollama's models and hid a held server's model for up to 30 s.

findings.evidence: The model list of a node with fresh reports now comes only from its agent's OLLAMA reports, not from a router poll in between. Both the report and the poll travel through the same authenticated agent tunnel and are assertions of that host (B3), so an approved agent already controlled both; the change does not widen what a node can claim. A stale or invalid report (ollama_push_ts reset to 0, or older than PUSH_STALE_S) falls back to the full poll answer as before; a tunnel loss resets the timestamp. No route, authentication, payload or configuration change.
findings.resolution: Same trust as the existing push path (poll_loop already skipped nodes with fresh reports); covered by the self-test for fresh and stale reports.

tests.evidence: all PASS (12 checks); the two new checks fail without the fix (models lose the held server's model, as observed in production).
exit code 0, 332 PASS lines, no FAIL.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/selftest_control_flow.py; python test/check_control_flow.py; python test/selftest_english_names.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings.

limitations: Reproduced and diagnosed in a live deployment through the 0.32.3 journal line; the fix is verified by self-test and will be confirmed by a router restart followed by an immediate request for the held server's model.
